name: What specific improvements can I expect from an AEO audit?
description: An AEO audit provides actionable steps to improve content structure, data optimization, and semantic relevance for better AI visibility and search performance.

mainEntity.name: What specific improvements can I expect from an AEO audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: From an AEO audit, you can expect a detailed report outlining actionable recommendations to enhance your website's AI visibility. This includes suggestions for improving content structure for entity extraction, optimizing data for AI interpretation, refining semantic relevance, and ensuring content aligns with user intent. The goal is to make your website's information more readily discoverable and accurately represented by AI systems, leading to increased organic traffic and better engagement.
